raw_text: `.rulesync/` is the source of truth. Author changes in `rules`, `skills`, `subagents`, `commands`, `hooks`, and `mcp` there first. Validate and regenerate with the system-wide `rulesync` binary: use `rulesync generate --check` as the consistency gate, then `rulesync generate` when changes are intentional. do not hand-edit generated target directories. Verify target configurations using `.rulesync/verification/` checklists.
